description: List or search England's registered historic battlefields (from Hastings-era sites to the Civil War): name with battle year, date registered, area in hectares, grid reference and official link. For history fans, schools and walkers asking where a battle was fought. Source: Historic England Register of Historic Battlefields. Covers only the registered sites in England, not every recorded battle. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, optional, part of the battlefield name, e.g. 'Barnet' (omit to list all)

name: battlefield_search
